_rule: Predicted relative change of the scene colour before post (5c3fdabc float mean) of each ON shot against its OFF neighbours, written and committed BEFORE the run (tools/m4_promotion_gate.py; a later commit is post hoc and does not pass). null: no change predicted.

shot-on.source: rt_water_rr_hitdist only changes RR's specular hit distance on water pixels (its history reprojection), not any radiance: at a static camera the mean is unchanged
shot-on.cost_source: one R16F store per water pixel in water_reflect (already traced); within the OFF spread
shot-on.flicker: rot-on burst: pan_artifacts final-luma temporal events below both rot-off bursts (lower is the fix working); the OFF-a vs OFF-b difference is the noise. No size derived: RR's response to the hit distance is not modelled offline

shot-fgmv.source: rt_water_fg_mv changes only DLSS-G's motion vectors (generated frames); the pre-post energy is unchanged (wf5 160335: +1.32%, band 2.05%)
shot-fgmv.cost_source: the water_mv copy (wf4/wf5: no measurable change in the reflection lines)
shot-fgmv.flicker: presented frames (fg_present_flicker, 32 consecutive presents per turn): DLSS-G implicated if snap-off-a / snap-off-b show water_parity_ratio above rest_parity_ratio by more than their OFF-OFF difference and water_over_rest above snap-fgoff's; snap-fgmv then moves both towards snap-fgoff. Within the OFF spread everywhere: not FG (the game's water, wf3/wf4/wf5)

shot-glint.source: rt_water_glint_aa replaces each lit sun record's sun term by the tent-weighted mean of its valid neighbours' (weights renormalised): the mean over the water is kept, only spread; the energy measure (water-compose or the plain after-water dump) moves by edge effects at the water's border and shadow edges only, below the band
shot-glint.cost_source: one more full-screen 8x8 dispatch per water pass reading two record words and the target (water_glint) plus nine RGBA16F loads per composed pixel: about 0.03-0.05 ms, inside [water] compose GPU (0.41 ms)
shot-glint.flicker: rendered bursts (pan_artifacts, water mask): peak rate (luma_peak, new) of rot-glint below both OFFs by more than |off-a - off-b|; presented (fg_present_flicker): snap-glint water mean |second difference| below both OFFs. Not sized offline

shot-fgmv.source: rt_water_fg_mv changes only the motion vectors DLSS-G reads (generated frames, after the scene colour is dumped): the pre-post energy is unchanged
shot-fgmv.cost_source: the water_mv copy (wf4: inside [water] reflections GPU, no measurable change)
shot-fgmv.flicker: attribution of the display-rate switch: if DLSS-G misplaces the water with the bed's vectors, snap-off-a / snap-off-b show a water parity asymmetry (water_parity_ratio well above rest_parity_ratio) and a water/rest ratio above snap-fgoff's; snap-fgmv then brings both towards snap-fgoff. snap-noshadow and rot-noshadow (rt_water_shadows=0): if the 1-spp sun-disc ray toggles glints per frame at shadow edges, its water residual and peak rate fall below both OFFs. Compose lines per window (uncomposed 0 and flips 0 in wf4; lighting of this frame 0-12 of 120 frames in static and turn windows alike) are reported, not gated

shot-rrwater.source: rt_water_rr_mv changes only the motion vectors RR reads (our copy; FG and the core's passes keep the game's), not any radiance before post: the water-compose energy (5c3fdabc + the in-frame compose delta) is unchanged
shot-rrwater.cost_source: one full-screen RG16F copy of the game's vectors (2.7 Mpx, ~11 MB read + 11 MB write: ~0.01-0.02 ms at the 5090's bandwidth) plus two projections per water pixel; inside the [water] reflections GPU line (0.12 ms in wf2/wf3)
shot-rrwater.flicker: rot-rrwater: water-masked transient rate below both rot-off bursts by more than |off-a - off-b| if RR's reprojection of the water with the bed's motion is the flicker. rot-rroff (the game's DLSS SR instead of RR; the core's non-RR GI / D-LS / D-RF modes too): attribution only; clearly below both OFFs means the flicker is RR's handling of the water, within them means the game's water (its animated normals, probe) or the image whatever the upscaler. Not sized offline: the bed-vs-surface parallax per pixel during the turn is not measured

shot-nocompose.source: water-compose energy = 5c3fdabc + the in-frame compose delta. wf2 110212 at this save and pose: 5c3fdabc 0.1939, in-frame delta of the Ultra water keys -0.0217 (off-a / off-b mean; mostly the sun shadows removing glints, PLAN_M5_WATER M5.3c). With every water image key off the delta is the next pass's own draws only (+0.0001, m5w3 OFF): (0.1940 - 0.1722) / 0.1722 = +12.6%
shot-nocompose.cost_source: the [water] compose GPU line (lighting copy + compose dispatches with the sun, local-light and refraction rays) was 0.41 ms in every wf2 window; off, it does not run
shot-nocompose.flicker: attribution, no fix: water-masked transient rate (pan_artifacts --mask, the rotating rt_debug 21 trace) of rot-nocompose vs rot-off-a / rot-off-b (wf2: 2.25 / 2.32%, OFF spread 0.07 points). Within the OFF spread or above: the flicker is the game's own water (its animated normals and probe); clearly below both: ours (the compose: the hit / miss and hidden switches, the shadow ray noise)

shot-rr.source: rt_water_rr_hitdist only changes RR's specular hit distance on water pixels, not any radiance: at a static camera the mean is unchanged (wf1 100826: -0.10%, band 1.25%)
shot-rr.cost_source: one R16F store per water pixel in water_reflect (wf1: water reflections 0.119 ms in all three windows)
shot-rr.flicker: rot-rr burst: pan_artifacts final-luma transient pixel-frames per calibrated pixel-frame below both rot-off bursts by more than |off-a - off-b|, whole frame and inside the water mask (wf1 100826: 1.65% vs 2.20 / 2.18%, confounded by direction and toggle timing)

shot-edge.source: rt_water_rf_edge changes the composed term only where its hit lies within rf_edge (0.05 uv) of the screen border (w < 1); everywhere else the image is the key-off image. There it moves toward the probe value by (1 - w)(A L - B): the frame mean moves by the border-band share of the composed water only, below the shot band. Measured in-frame (job energy_fs water-compose): the whole reflection compose is -0.12% / -0.19% of the frame there (m5w3 121606, m5p1 213849 step), the edge key undoes a fraction of it (hits within 5% of the border), so |d| under 0.2%
shot-edge.cost_source: a few ALU per composed pixel in water_compose (no ray, no memory access): within the OFF spread
shot-edge.flicker: rot-edge burst: inside the water mask, pan_artifacts final-luma transient pixel-frames below both rot-off bursts by more than |off-a - off-b|; whole frame at most the water share (may stay within noise). Not sized offline: the share of composed hits within 5% of the border during the turn is not measured. A null here says the screen-border switch is not the flicker (next: the hidden / same-surface switch, tier 2)
